What to expect # I’ll be writing about:
Python & Django — Backend engineering, architecture patterns, and real-world solutions Developer Tools — The terminal, editors, and workflows that keep me productive Open Source — Projects I build and contribute to Career — Lessons learned as a software engineer The stack # This site is powered by:
Hugo — The world’s fastest static site generator Blowfish — A Tailwind CSS-based theme with profile layouts, card views, and i18n GitHub Pages — Free, reliable hosting JetBrains Mono — The font that ties everything together with an Omarchy-inspired aesthetic Stay tuned for more. 🚀
